doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His current band, and wanting more years
summary: Hamilton wants another birthday, lists his current group at his home rehearsals, and notes an upcoming conference performance.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well again, looking back, what we discussed the last two days, you had such an enormous career. Is there anything else you would like to continue, other then finding time for yourself to read?
Yeah, anything I want to do, continue -­
Is there anything you haven’t done that you want to do?
Yeah, I want to do some more of it.
My last birthday, people asked me what did I want for my birthday. I want another one.
I’ll have to remember that one. And your current band, you said they’re going to be here, rehearsing right here.
Don’t have to worry about piano. But you’ve got a whole rig over there. What have you got? You’re still composing?
Still composing for the group. Who’s in the group right now?
Same guys.(?) Same guys I told you. Kerry Denigress on guitar, Paul Ramsay on bass, Ebon Swann on reeds, Jeffrey Contrabandon reeds, and Jeremiah Goodman, percussion. It’s cool.
And they’re rehearsing here, and you’re performing where on Thursday?
Where, in the (?)Mayco Room? I’ve got it written down over there somewhere.
Part of the upcoming International Association of Jazz Education conference.
Yeah. You’ve got something else there now where we can get a little more contemporary? I don’t know.
